newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone-Poulenc weighs buying all of subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Rhone-Poulenc weighs buying all of subsidiary.

text.p: Rhone-Poulenc said on Thursday it was weighing buying 100 percent of the outstanding shares of Rhone-Poulenc Rorer, in which it currently has a 68.3 percent stake.
It said it was considering paying minority shareholders $92 per share in the purchase.
In a statement, the firm estimated the cost of the transaction at 25 billion francs, and said it would have to increase its capital by seven billion francs to carry out the purchase.
It said it also was studying a regrouping of its chemical and fibre and polymer operations in a single new unit, to be taken public in 1998.
